findings.claim: STM Q3 2026 net revenue $3.76B (+17.9% YoY); segments YoY: AM&S $1,560M +8.8%, P&D $477M +11.3%, EMP $1,212M +24.1%, RFOC $504M +46.2%; P&D operating loss widened from $67M to $81M; Q4 guide midpoint $4.15B, GM 39.0%
findings.source: STMicroelectronics Form 6-K Q3 2026 earnings press release (SEC)

findings.claim: Q2 2026 call: book-to-bill close to 2, demand and backlog exceed capacity; overall pricing expected broadly flat to slightly higher (easier for distribution/STM32, large customers contract-set); may lose some share at existing customers as new suppliers enter; data-center revenue >$1B in 2026 and well above $2B in 2027
findings.source: Nasdaq: STMicroelectronics Q2 Earnings Call Highlights AI Data Center Growth

findings.claim: WSTS Q2 2026 update: H1 2026 market $702B (+102% YoY); 2027 about $2.1T (~29% growth), memory-led; spring forecast 2026 about $1.51T
findings.source: WSTS Global Semiconductor Market records exceptional growth in Q2 2026
